trigger.decision: The marginal correction fixes the length fault, but this MetaMathQA cell is surface-saturated. Its near-zero broad association load cannot be called a reasoning-information result.

mandatory_surface_control.method: TF-IDF cosine over lower-case alphanumeric prompt and trace-body tokens, evaluated in the exact same K-way blocks
mandatory_surface_control.rule: Report its accuracy, margin, and block-wise random-assignment p-value beside every frozen-model retrieval result.
mandatory_surface_control.interpretation: When the surface matcher places every trace, broad retrieval measures problem-trace association but cannot isolate reasoning beyond lexical overlap. Keep the result and mark the cell surface-saturated; do not discard it or rename it a failure.

primary_controlled_core.why: Procedural generators hold task family and wording fixed while instance seed and declared difficulty vary. Exact scorers support both task accuracy and GRPO reward without a learned judge.
primary_controlled_core.family_conditioned_probe: Form K-way blocks within one generator and one declared difficulty. Different seeds set the instance. The surface matcher remains mandatory. Call the corrected model score L_instance only when the block is not surface-saturated.
primary_controlled_core.natural_data_role: MetaMathQA, NuminaMath-CoT, OpenR1-Math, and later CodeForces remain external-validity tests. They do not define the controlled difficulty axis.
primary_controlled_core.difficulty_rule: Use fixed generator settings shared across models. Do not tune each task to each model after observing reward or accuracy. A pilot may reject a setting as all-zero or all-one reward, but replacement settings must be frozen before their results open.

grpo_path.package_contract: TRL 0.21.0 computes and returns prompt IDs, prompt masks, completion IDs, completion masks, optional old and reference token log probabilities, and one scalar advantage per completion.
grpo_path.fixed_buffer: Capture those tensors and verifier rewards once from the frozen start policy. Reuse the byte-identical buffer for aligned and permuted-credit adapter updates.
grpo_path.credit_change: Only replace the advantages tensor with the matched bijection from src/fineqcomp/grpo_control.py. Keep prompt, completion, reward, masks, old-policy scores, and reference scores unchanged.
grpo_path.runtime_gate: A 32-prompt, four-completion smoke must show finite loss and gradients, at most 25 percent zero-spread prompt groups, at least 75 percent changed advantages, and the locked donor-length bound before any on-policy run.

native_evaluation_gate.fault_found_in_code_audit: Natural math evaluation currently stops every model at 512 new tokens, while the model smoke generates only two tokens. Neither check proves that a native thinking model reaches an answer.
native_evaluation_gate.required_before_micro_pilot: On frozen prompts, report answer extraction and EOS termination at the proposed maximum generation length. Raise the limit only in a recorded pre-pilot amendment, and measure the added time and memory before a codec grid.
